notes.title: Announcement of Game Payment Mode Change
notes.content: Hello players, it has been 4 months since the game was launched. Due to the need to bear high server fees, we have decided to adjust the game from free mode to paid buyout mode on December 8th. Players who already own the game will not be affected. Thank you for your support and love for the game.

notes.title: New Multi-Language Support for Global Gaming Experience
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce that to better serve players around the globe and enable more players from different countries and regions to enjoy our game, we have added support for the following languages:

German
French
Italian
Brazilian Portuguese
Spanish
Russian
With this update, our game now supports the following 11 languages:

Simplified Chinese
Traditional Chinese
English
Japanese
Korean
German
French
Italian
Brazilian Portuguese
Spanish
Russian
We believe this update will greatly enhance your gaming experience, making the language environment in the game more familiar and natural. Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to exploring more fun in the game world with you!

If there are any inappropriate translations, please feel free to help us correct them.

Happy gaming!
